scenario: 今天 10 篇覆盖一条问答链路的几个环节。检索环节里，一篇分析混合检索在哪些查询上不如只用向量检索，Lean Finder V2 用强化学习生成短查询来训练定理检索，SurveyGraph 沿方法关系图为综述检索论文。RAG 链路上，有论文测量知识库修订后要重算多少分块向量，CANOPY 把多模态检索结果裁到需要的粒度。还有论文用一次前向代替层级 RAG 里的串行解码，GBOR-RAG 则从基因图里取证据子图。问答端的 JCA 让模型逐条核对问题里的条件。工业侧有阿里云 AI Search 的全栈优化和腾讯云 TokenHub 的联网搜索接口。

papers.title: The Fusion Tax: A Diagnostic Analysis of When Hybrid Retrieval Hurts
papers.summary: 混合检索把 BM25 这类按词匹配的稀疏检索和向量检索的结果融合成一个排序，平均分上它总能赢，可逐条查询看，13–48% 的查询比当条查询上较好的那一路更差。这篇论文换了一种记账方式：逐条查询比较融合前后的 nDCG@10，把不融合也当作一个正式选项。作者把这部分逐条损失叫作“融合税”。损失集中在只有一路检索命中相关文档的查询上，另一路此时只贡献噪声。把向量编码器换大、在融合后加交叉编码器重排，这笔税都没有消失。
papers.abstract: Hybrid retrieval, which fuses a sparse lexical retriever with a dense neural one, is widely recommended in the software documentation surveyed in September 2026, usually with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), on the strength of aggregate gains. We ask what fusion costs on individual queries, treating "do not fuse" as a first-class outcome, in the setting in which hybrid retrieval is deployed: a standard Anserini BM25, five dense encoders spanning 22M-596M parameters and three model generations, a learned-sparse (SPLADE) alternative, and a cross-encoder second stage, on seven BEIR datasets and three fusion functions. Even the best method, dense-weighted score interpolation, ranks relevant documents below the better of its two components on 13-48% of queries and below the deployable dense-only retriever on 8-21%, while beating dense-only in aggregate on every corpus with the primary encoder; the downside is significant under loss-averse risk-sensitive evaluation on six of the seven corpora. We call this loss the fusion tax. It is mostly a ranking effect that preserves recall in aggregate, it is most likely on the queries that only one retriever covers, and it persists across the encoder ladder and the SPLADE substitution. RRF carries the higher tax wherever the dense retriever is clearly stronger and only beats dense-only where the two components are balanced. Fusion failure is weakly predictable within a corpus but transfers unreliably across corpora, because the features that predict it change sign with the sparse-dense balance. A cross-encoder recovers part of the tax only where it is itself reliable. We distill these findings into guidance that keys the fusion decision to the measured sparse-dense balance of the target corpus.

deep_reading.title: The Fusion Tax: A Diagnostic Analysis of When Hybrid Retrieval Hurts

papers.title: Chunk Recomputation under Real Document Revisions: Measuring Update Cost and Retrieval Quality of Fixed, Recursive, and Content-Defined Chunking
papers.authors: Yuning Bian, Lele Xu, Yifan Yuan, Xinyu Yin, Chengyan Zhan
papers.summary: RAG 的分块方案几乎都只在一份静态语料上比较，可知识库里的文档一直在改。每个块单独编码成向量，一次编辑如果让块边界移动，边界两侧的块就成了新的编码输入，哪怕里面的字一个没改。作者取相邻版本的中英文维基百科条目，只有块的完整编码输入和旧版本逐字节相同才复用旧向量。比较的是固定长度切块、段落优先的递归切块和内容定义切块，最后一种在几个词宽的滑动窗口上算哈希，哈希值满足预设条件的位置就是切点。固定长度切块要重算新版本 57–68% 的编码输入，而三者的证据召回率在同一种语言内相差不到 2 个百分点。固定长度切块在插入点之后整体平移，后面的窗口都对不上旧版本，所以重算最多。
papers.abstract: Chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation are almost always evaluated on a static snapshot, yet the documents underlying a knowledge base continue to change. Because chunks are embedded independently, a boundary that moves after an edit forces unchanged text to be re-embedded. We measure this update cost on 120 pairs of adjacent Chinese and English Wikipedia revisions for three stateless chunkers (non-overlapping fixed-size, recursive paragraph-first, and content-defined chunking) under a strict byte-identical reuse rule and a frozen dense encoder. On the 116-article common-success pool, with frozen, length-calibrated parameters, fixed-size chunking recomputes 57-68% of its full new-version embedding-input workload, recursive chunking 38-56%, and content-defined chunking 43-54%, while at these parameters mean evidence recall under a fixed 2048-token retrieval budget differs by less than two percentage points within either language. A cost-only parameter grid shows that the ranking of the two content-aware chunkers changes with chunk-length settings, whereas non-overlapping fixed-size chunking has the highest recomputation cost in every length-matched condition. Update cost is therefore a substantial, parameter-sensitive dimension that static retrieval evaluations do not expose and that should be reported alongside retrieval quality.

deep_reading.title: Chunk Recomputation under Real Document Revisions: Measuring Update Cost and Retrieval Quality of Fixed, Recursive, and Content-Defined Chunking

papers.title: Lean Finder V2: Semantic Search for Mathlib That Disambiguates User Queries
papers.authors: Jialin Lu, Xiaoyu Liu, Hengrui Luo, Rodrigo Stehling, Linxi Liu, Weiran Sun, Yuepeng Wang, Wuyang Chen
papers.summary: 写证明的人和编码智能体都要先在 Lean 证明助手的数学库 Mathlib 里搜到合适的定理。真实的搜索查询很短，短查询会省略很多意图，同一句话可能对应好几条相近的定理。Lean Finder V2 从两头解决这个问题。模型一侧，作者用强化学习训练一个查询生成器，专门为每条定理写当前检索器排不准、但意思仍然对得上的短查询。用这些查询训练检索器，再用新检索器给生成器打分，交替两轮。输入一侧，作者自动优化一个改写提示词：用候选提示词改写一批合成查询，看检索器把目标定理排到第几，只保留排名有改进的版本，检索前用它改写用户的短查询。在人写短查询组成的 MathlibQR 上，Lean Finder V2 的 Recall@10 是 0.893，此前最好的检索加重排系统是 0.780。
papers.abstract: We introduce Lean Finder V2, a semantic search framework for Mathlib that disambiguates user queries through complementary model-level adversarial training and input-level query rewriting. Human mathematicians and coding agents rarely search Mathlib by providing detailed context. In practice, they query short properties, notation, aliases, or hypotheses, leaving much of the intended mathematics implicit. In contrast, existing Mathlib search engines unrealistically assume context-rich queries. The scarcity of real-world short queries paired with ground-truth Mathlib statements makes this ambiguity even more intractable. We argue that this is essentially a data problem. Through adversarial training, we scale up the generation of labeled short and ambiguous queries, and learn to disambiguate user queries at both model-level fine-tuning and input-level query rewriting. On the human-curated MathlibQR benchmark, our Lean Finder V2 sets a new state of the art, with at least 11% relative improvement over the previous best Mathlib semantic search engines. On top of our state-of-the-art retriever, optimized query rewriting further improves MathlibQR retrieval. On unlabeled queries from human and coding-agent interactions, Lean Finder V2 is ranked as the strongest system. Integrated with Claude Code, Lean Finder V2 improves proof success on downstream theorem-proving task.

deep_reading.title: Lean Finder V2: Semantic Search for Mathlib That Disambiguates User Queries

papers.title: CANOPY: Adaptive-Granularity Evidence Compression for Multimodal RAG
papers.authors: Hyojeong Yun, Jueun Kim, Wook-Shin Han
papers.summary: 多模态 RAG 把检索结果交给模型前先压缩时，保留多大一块不能一刀切，有时要整张表，有时一行，有时一句话。CANOPY 按问题逐块决定保留粒度，在答对率相当的情况下，把交给模型的证据 token 减少 14.2% 到 27.7%。它把每条检索结果组织成层层嵌套的区域，比如整张表、几行、单独一行，用一个训练过的编码器给每个区域和问题的相关程度打分；小区域的分数不低于所在的大区域时就换成小区域，否则保留更大的上下文。另有一个大模型检查证据还缺哪条事实，缺就再搜一次，新结果同样先压缩。压缩证据时，该留多大一块要看问题，有时一整行比一句话更有用。
papers.abstract: Multimodal RAG retrieves text, tables, images, and videos, but choosing a retrieval granularity does not determine how much context to retain within each item. Coarse units include irrelevant content, while uniformly fine selection can remove context needed to interpret the evidence. Existing compressors address this trade-off with modality-specific mechanisms, leaving open a shared procedure for adapting the retained extent region by region across heterogeneous items. We introduce CANOPY (Canonical Projection over Hierarchy), a framework for adaptive-granularity post-retrieval evidence compression. CANOPY represents retrieved items as hierarchies and uses a node encoder fine-tuned on gold evidence to score regions against the query. Parent-relative refinement compares these scores to select multiple regions at different granularities without LLM calls for node-level pruning. Because compression cannot recover evidence that was never retrieved, a critic requests targeted follow-up retrieval when it judges the accumulated evidence insufficient; newly retrieved items are compressed before being added. Across five QA benchmarks over a 33M-item heterogeneous corpus, CANOPY achieves higher average answer accuracy than the evaluated retrieval baselines. In the unrouted Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct setting, compression reduces reader-input evidence tokens by 14.2-27.7% relative to the same iterative pipeline without compression, with comparable answer accuracy.

papers.title: 从 VDBBench 到 MMEB 榜首：阿里云 AI Search 从引擎到模型的全栈优化
papers.summary: 阿里云说，它给 Elasticsearch 加上自研的 C++ 查询内核 FalconSeek 之后，在 Rally Big5 这组典型 ES 查询上，耗时的几何平均快了约 6.87 倍。ES 照旧负责 API、写入和集群管理，只把倒排遍历、排序、聚合和向量召回这些最耗时的查询步骤交给 C++ 内核执行，暂不支持的查询退回 ES 原来的执行方式。向量检索先用压缩过的向量在 HNSW 图上找候选，再读原始向量精排，在一千万条向量的测试集上召回率约 0.98 时，每秒能处理 8 万多次查询。模型一侧，他们开源的多模态文档 embedding 模型在 MMEB VisDoc 榜单上排第一。这些都是厂商自己的测试，文中也提醒各对比对象的机器规格并不一致。==给 agent 供上下文的搜索，要把引擎和模型放在一起优化==。
papers.abstract: 当 Agent 开始进入生产环境，搜索正在从找到相关文档的工具升级为持续供给高质量上下文的基础设施。AI Search 不再只是搜索引擎，而是贯穿模型理解、向量与全文召回、混合检索、融合重排和引擎执行的完整链路。阿里云 AI Search 在 VDBBench 向量检索、Big5 与 Tantivy 传统检索，以及 MMEB 多模态文档检索等评测中进行全栈优化。

papers.title: 大模型服务平台 TokenHub 联网搜索
papers.summary: 大模型的知识有时效，回答今天天气怎样这类问题得上网查。腾讯云 TokenHub 把联网搜索做成了模型自己调用的工具：打开以后，模型自己判断要不要查、写什么搜索词，再根据搜索结果组织回答，并标出引用来源。开发者只需要选轻量版还是标准版，以及每轮注入多少搜索内容，搜几次由模型自己决定。这是一份产品接口文档，没有效果测试。
papers.abstract: 联网搜索是 TokenHub 提供的模型增强能力。开启后，大模型在回答时可自动调用搜索引擎获取实时网络信息，解决模型知识时效性不足的问题。平台支持 Responses API 与 Chat Completions API 两种协议，模型可自主判断是否需要搜索、搜索什么关键词，并基于搜索结果生成回答，同时通过结构化 annotations 返回引用来源。

papers.title: Joint Constraint Aggregation for Qualifier-Sensitive Retrieval-Augmented QA
papers.authors: Jennifer Hsia, Zachary C. Lipton, Aarti Singh
papers.summary: 检索到的段落如果更常提到一个只满足部分条件的错误答案，模型就容易被带偏；把每个候选放在同一组条件下逐条核对，再一起比较，能明显减少这种错误。在 AmbigQA 里检索偏向错误答案的难题上，Qwen3-30B 直接一步步推理答对 86.4%，用这个方法答对 93.5%。做法分三步。先把问题拆成每个候选都必须满足的条件，比如问哪位女演员说过某句台词，答案就必须是女演员而不是她扮演的角色。再对照检索到的段落逐个检查候选，写下是否满足以及理由。最后把所有候选的报告放在一起比较，选出满足全部条件的那个。问题带限定条件时，先逐条核对再比较，比直接作答更稳。
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented QA can fail even when the correct answer is in the retrieved evidence. This can happen when a competing answer satisfies some, but not all, of the question's requirements and is mentioned frequently in the retrieved documents, which can make it appear to be the best-supported answer. To test whether this retrieval skew actually affects the decision, we manipulate it directly: increasing the prevalence of passages that favor the competing answer makes the model more likely to select it. This points to a decision problem that candidate-level support alone cannot resolve. We therefore introduce Joint Constraint Aggregation (JCA), which compares candidates against the same question-derived requirements using the retrieved evidence. Across three evaluation settings and three instruction-tuned backbones, JCA improves overall accuracy, and its advantage grows when retrieval favors a competing answer. Together, these results suggest that when partial matches and retrieval prominence pull models toward a competing answer, comparing candidates against the question's full requirements can make selection more reliable.

papers.title: Compiling Autoregressive LLM Control into Policy-Exact Parallel Inference for Hierarchical RAG
papers.authors: Zehao Lin, Qianfeng Shen, Xixuan Hao, Shaobo Cui, Chunyu Li, Kai Chen, Bo Tang, Zhenjun Wang, Jin Yan, Zhiyu Li, Feiyu Xiong
papers.summary: 分层 RAG 里，大模型要从候选章节里挑出几节往下读，通常是一个 token 一个 token 地写出选择，其实可以一次算完，选出的章节和逐个生成基本一致，挑选环节的延迟降低 35% 到 47%。每个候选章节绑定一个单 token 的标签，模型在该写下一个标签的位置给出的 logits 里，只看这些标签，就得到各章节的得分。先处理一遍提示，按得分选出第一节。贪心地连选三节时，第一节定下后，后面只会用到几种前缀：只含第一节的，以及第一节加某个候选第二节的；把这些前缀全排进一段输入，每个前缀只能看到提示和它自己前面的部分。一次前向计算就拿到每个前缀下各章节的得分：只含第一节的前缀给出第二节，接上这个第二节的前缀再给出第三节。
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly act as controllers in structured decision pipelines, yet their decisions are still executed by autoregressive text decoding. Hierarchical RAG is one such setting: at each frontier of a document tree, an LLM commits to b of k sections under an input-dependent action grammar, executed as either failure-prone free-form JSON or reliable but strictly serial grammar-constrained generation. We show that this serialization is unnecessary for bounded-horizon control: the reachable future forms a shallow action-prefix tree, which we compile—one root prefill plus one tree-causal probe evaluate every prefix-conditioned action distribution with serial decoding's tokens, positions, and causal ancestry. A prefix-state lemma makes compiled control policy-exact in exact arithmetic: the same policy with a two-forward critical path and zero output tokens. One further probe pass certifies the exact order-marginalized MAP set. Across four document-disjoint splits and two scales on the primary MetaX device, compiled control matches the serial policy on 84-89% of questions and cuts control latency by 35-47% versus token-wise serial decoding and 6-7% versus an idealized chunked engine; an H800 repetition preserves the ordering.

papers.title: SurveyGraph: Generating Academic Surveys via Methods-Entity Knowledge Graphs
papers.authors: Yifan Yuan, Yancheng Zhu, Zuoyu Zhang, Xiaogang Peng
papers.summary: 自动写综述时，把论文之间谁扩展了谁、谁改进了谁建成图，再沿着图找文献，引用会更有依据，但图里的关系本身也会出错。用一批大模型函数调用论文建一张图，再用 Qwen 写一篇综述，和同样的论文、同样的大纲但去掉图关系的版本相比，带引用的句子能被所引论文支撑的比例高了 2.8 个百分点。SurveyGraph 把方法、任务、数据集等实体连成图，写每一节时沿着图上的关系找相关论文，再生成和修改；证据不足的关系可以在用来检索之前过滤掉。人工抽查 108 条关系，只有 68.5% 完全或部分成立，比如有一条说某篇科学工具使用的论文扩展了 API-Bank，可 API-Bank 是评测基准，不是前一代方法。
papers.abstract: Most automated survey generation systems retrieve papers as flat documents, limiting their ability to capture research structure. We present SurveyGraph, a framework built around a Methods-Entity Knowledge Graph (MEKG) encoding method-level follow-on, competition, and shared-resource relations. The graph supports core-paper discovery, retrieval, hybrid outlining, and evidence-gated narrative synthesis. We evaluate retrieval, semantic edges, citation grounding, collection coverage, and generation-stage components. In a controlled seven-method equal-budget benchmark, MEKG-anchored fusion balances recall and structural density, with an independent co-citation check. In a separate archived graph-native diagnostic, graph-aware retrieval nearly doubles recall over flat lexical baselines across eight runs (p = 0.004). A semantic evidence gate achieves AUC = 0.75. Audits of 160 generated sentences find 80.6% anchored-or-partial citation support. Human adjudication of 108 stratified semantic edges finds 68.5% supported-or-partial relations. A SurveyBench-facing collection probe reaches mean reference coverage of 0.521 across four topics with an eight-paper budget.

venue.name: EMNLP
venue.label: EMNLP 2026
venue.evidence: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Findings. 34 pages including appendices

papers.title: Automated Enrichment Analysis with GraphRAG: Efficient Multi-Database ORA Extraction and Biological Interpretation
papers.authors: Guangcan Li, Shuyuan Zheng, Jiayao Liu, Shigeto Seno, Makoto Onizuka
papers.summary: 把多个基因集数据库合成一张知识图谱做富集分析，结果和传统做法几乎一样，查询却快得多，还能看出不同条目通过哪些基因相连。富集分析看一组表达明显变化的基因是否集中在某条已知通路或功能条目里，传统做法对每个数据库分别跑一遍，得到几张互不相连的列表。这里把各数据库的条目和它们注释的基因建成一张图，共享基因把不同库的条目连起来。每个条目按变化基因是否明显偏多打分，再在多收高分条目和少连边之间权衡，取出一小片经共享基因连通的子图，连不过来的高分条目舍掉，交给大模型写解释。在 42 个真实查询上，查询时间的中位数快了 37 倍，各条目得分和传统做法的皮尔逊相关系数平均是 0.997。
papers.abstract: Over-representation analysis (ORA) is widely used to interpret gene-expression studies, but its outputs are often fragmented across gene-set databases and presented as flat term lists that obscure gene-level links among related enrichment signals. We propose Graph-Based Over-Representation Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GBOR-RAG), an integrated and traceable framework for ORA interpretation. GBOR-RAG represents heterogeneous gene-set databases as a unified term-gene knowledge graph, where shared genes connect related terms across sources. After graph-based ORA scoring, the framework retrieves a compact connected evidence subgraph that preserves both cross-database relationships and gene-level support. The subgraph conditions an LLM to generate biological interpretations, and we introduce a claim-level faithfulness metric to assess whether generated claims are supported by explicit evidence. Experiments show that graph-based ORA preserves conventional ORA results with high consistency (mean Pearson r=0.997) while reducing query time by a median of 37x (up to 48x). The retrieved subgraphs average 36.8 nodes and achieve the highest overall integration score (4.12), and GBOR-RAG attains the highest claim-level faithfulness (0.90) among the compared systems. Adding a PubMed literature layer further improves the overall interpretation quality from 4.17 to 4.75.
